name: org.machanism.machai:genai-client
description: GenAI Client is a Java library for integrating Machai applications with generative AI providers through a consistent provider abstraction. It provides the org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.Genai contract for conversational prompt execution, system instructions, tool-aware generation, request input logging, project-directory context, provider state clearing, and runtime configuration. It provides org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.EmbeddingProvider for embedding vectors used in semantic search, similarity comparison, and natural language processing. The library includes provider implementations for OpenAI-compatible APIs, Anthropic Claude APIs, EPAM CodeMie OAuth-backed endpoints, and a local YAML-driven ToolsProvider for deterministic host-side tool invocation. It includes provider resolution through org.machanism.machai.ai.manager.GenaiProviderManager using Provider:Model identifiers such as OpenAI:gpt-4o-mini, Anthropic:claude-3-5-sonnet, CodeMie:gpt-4o-mini, or a fully qualified provider class name. It includes usage accounting through immutable Usage records and the synchronized UsageStatistics registry. It includes a function-tool SPI with FunctionTools, FunctionToolsLoader, ToolFunction, Tool, Prompt, Resource, Param, SupportedFor, ParamDescriptor, Role, and SpecialException, enabling Java ServiceLoader discovery of annotated tools, prompts, and resources that can be registered with AI providers. Supported capabilities include OpenAI Responses API generation, OpenAI embeddings, Anthropic Messages API generation, Anthropic web search versions, OpenAI web_search_preview, MCP server registration, local Java function tools, reusable prompt methods, resource callbacks, configurable error handling, token usage capture, CodeMie authentication with password grant or client credentials, and provider-independent application integration for automated content generation, semantic search, intelligent project assembly, tool orchestration, and model-assisted workflows.

usageContext: Java applications that need a vendor-neutral GenAI provider API
Machai modules that need prompt execution, embeddings, and function-tool registration
Applications that need OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Claude, CodeMie, MCP, web-search, or local tool execution integrations
Projects that need runtime token usage tracking and provider resolution from Provider:Model strings

constructors.description: Utility class for resolving and initializing generative AI and embedding providers. Applications normally use its static methods rather than keeping an instance.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator config = null;
org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.Genai provider = org.machanism.machai.ai.manager.GenaiProviderManager.getProvider("OpenAI:gpt-4o-mini", config);
examples.description: Resolves a Genai provider from a Provider:Model string. The provider token OpenAI maps to org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.impl.OpenAIProvider and the model token is passed to provider initialization.

constructors.description: Creates an OpenAI-compatible provider that adapts the Machai Genai and EmbeddingProvider APIs to the OpenAI Java SDK Responses API and embedding API. Configure it with OPENAI_API_KEY, optional OPENAI_BASE_URL, GENAI_TIMEOUT, MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, MAX_TOOL_CALLS, WebSearchTool properties, and MCP properties.

examples.description: Creates, configures, uses, and clears an OpenAI-backed provider. The configuration object should provide OPENAI_API_KEY and optional provider settings.

constructors.description: Creates an Anthropic-backed provider that adapts the Machai Genai API to Anthropic Claude Messages API workflows with prompt execution, function tools, optional web search, MCP forwarding, and usage tracking.

examples.description: Creates and uses an Anthropic provider. The configuration object should provide ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and optional Anthropic settings.

constructors.description: Creates a provider that authenticates against CodeMie OpenID Connect endpoints, obtains an OAuth 2.0 access token, configures downstream API credentials, and delegates requests to OpenAIProvider or AnthropicProvider based on the model prefix.

examples.description: Creates and uses a CodeMie provider. The configuration object should provide GENAI_USERNAME, GENAI_PASSWORD, and optional AUTH_URL values.

constructors.description: Creates a local tool-execution provider. When initialized with the yaml model, it interprets the last prompt as a YAML descriptor containing a tool name and parameters, then invokes the matching registered ToolFunction locally. It disables conversational error handling by default so tool failures are propagated immediately.

examples.description: Creates a local tool provider and invokes it with YAML-style tool-call input after tools have been registered.

constructors.description: Discovers FunctionTools implementations from the classpath using Java ServiceLoader and stores them for later application to a Genai provider. Tool bundles can be restricted to application classes with SupportedFor.

examples.description: Discovers FunctionTools implementations declared in META-INF/services/org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.FunctionTools and applies compatible tool and prompt methods to a provider.

features.name: getProvider
features.signature: public static org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.Genai getProvider(java.lang.String chatModel, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator conf)
features.description: Dynamically loads and initializes a Genai provider from a Provider:Model string. If the provider token contains a dot, it is treated as a fully qualified class name. Otherwise, it is resolved with the org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.impl.{Provider}Provider convention. The model token is passed to init.

examples.description: Resolves an OpenAI-compatible provider, configures conversation instructions, submits a prompt, and executes the provider.

features.name: getEmbeddingProvider
features.description: Dynamically loads and initializes an EmbeddingProvider using the same Provider:Model resolution strategy. It verifies that the resolved class implements EmbeddingProvider before returning it.

examples.description: Obtains an embedding provider and generates an embedding vector for semantic search or similarity comparison.

features.name: Genai lifecycle
features.description: The Genai contract supports provider initialization, prompts, instructions, state clearing, tool registration, prompt registration, resource registration, project directory context, input logging, error handling mode, enabled tool filtering, and response generation.

examples.snippet: org.machanism.machanism_placeholder.Placeholder placeholder = null;
examples.description: Do not use this placeholder example in application code. Use a concrete org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.Genai provider resolved through GenaiProviderManager or instantiated from org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.impl.
Shows the common lifecycle for a Genai provider: configure context, set instructions, add a prompt, perform generation, and clear accumulated state.

features.name: OpenAI provider execution
features.description: Executes an OpenAI Responses API request using accumulated prompts, instructions, registered tools, optional web search tools, optional MCP server tools, and configured limits. If the model requests tool calls, matching ToolFunction handlers are invoked and the conversation continues until final text is produced.

examples.description: Runs a practical OpenAI-backed prompt. Configure OPENAI_API_KEY in the provider Configurator before using it in production.

features.name: Embedding generation
features.signature: public java.util.List<java.lang.Double> embedding(java.lang.String text, long dimensions)
features.description: Generates an embedding vector for input text. Implemented by OpenAIProvider and CodeMieProvider for semantic search, similarity comparison, retrieval, classification, or embedding-powered application assembly.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.EmbeddingProvider provider = org.machanism.machai.ai.manager.GenaiProviderManager.getEmbeddingProvider("OpenAI:text-embedding-3-small", null);
java.util.List<java.lang.Double> embedding = provider.embedding("GenAI provider abstraction and tool calling", 1536L);
examples.description: Creates an embedding for a natural-language description that can be stored in a vector index for semantic retrieval.

features.name: addTools
features.description: Scans public methods on a FunctionTools implementation for Tool annotations, resolves tool names and descriptions, reads Param metadata, creates ParamDescriptor definitions, and registers each method as a callable tool for the provider.

examples.description: Defines a custom Java tool with fully qualified annotation names and registers it with a provider so the model can call it by the echo_text tool name.

features.name: addPrompts
features.description: Scans public methods on a FunctionTools implementation for Prompt annotations and registers reusable prompt callbacks with a role such as USER or ASSISTANT.

examples.description: Registers a reusable prompt method from a FunctionTools implementation.

features.name: applyTools
features.description: Applies FunctionTools implementations discovered by ServiceLoader to a provider. If a FunctionTools class has SupportedFor, it is applied only when the declared classes are compatible with the supplied appClass; otherwise it is considered globally compatible.

examples.description: Shows how to install the library as a Maven dependency, configure a ServiceLoader provider file, and invoke the loader so tool bundles become available to the Genai provider.

features.name: UsageStatistics
features.signature: public static void addUsage(java.lang.String modelId, org.machanism.machai.ai.manager.Usage usage)
features.description: Adds a Usage record for a model identifier. UsageStatistics also provides init, logUsage, logUsageForModel, getUsageForModel, and getAllModelUsages for operational reporting and diagnostics.

examples.description: Records and queries token usage for a model after a generation call.

customizations.name: FunctionTools
customizations.description: Implement this SPI to package Java-backed tools, prompts, and resources. Public methods annotated with Tool, Prompt, or Resource can be discovered and registered with providers. Register implementations in META-INF/services/org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.FunctionTools for ServiceLoader discovery.

examples.description: Creates a custom tool bundle and configures it for automatic discovery.

customizations.name: Provider configuration properties
customizations.description: Providers are configured through Configurator keys such as OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, GENAI_TIMEOUT, MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, MAX_TOOL_CALLS, WebSearchTool.type, WebSearchTool.city, WebSearchTool.country, WebSearchTool.region, MCP.url, MCP.name, MCP.description, MCP.authorization, GENAI_USERNAME, GENAI_PASSWORD, AUTH_URL, and cacheThreshold.

OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://api.openai.com/v1

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.Genai
studs.description: Gateway contract for generative AI provider integrations. It defines initialization, prompts, instructions, generation, clearing state, input logging, tool registration, prompt registration, resource registration, project directory configuration, error handling, and enabled tool filtering.

examples.description: Uses the Genai interface instead of a concrete provider implementation.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.EmbeddingProvider
studs.description: Gateway contract for providers that can generate embedding vectors from text. Implementations initialize with a model and Configurator, then return List<Double> vectors for semantic use cases.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.EmbeddingProvider provider = org.machanism.machai.ai.manager.GenaiProviderManager.getEmbeddingProvider("OpenAI:text-embedding-3-small", null);
java.util.List<java.lang.Double> vector = provider.embedding("example text", 1536L);
examples.description: Uses the EmbeddingProvider interface for semantic vector generation.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.FunctionTools
studs.description: Marker SPI for Java classes that contribute host-managed function tools, prompts, or resources to Genai providers. Implementations are often discovered through Java ServiceLoader.

examples.snippet:
public final class ExampleTools implements org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.FunctionTools {
}
examples.description: Defines a tool bundle class that can later expose annotated tool or prompt methods.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.AbstractAIProvider
studs.description: Base implementation of the Genai contract shared by concrete providers. It centralizes configuration handling, timeout handling, input logging, web search bootstrap, MCP server bootstrap, annotation-driven tool and prompt discovery, project directory context, enabled tool filtering, and guarded tool invocation.

examples.description: Uses inherited configuration behavior from AbstractAIProvider through a concrete OpenAIProvider.

examples.title: Install and use GenAI Client with Maven
steps: Add the Maven dependency org.machanism.machai:genai-client:1.2.2 to your Java project.
Provide provider configuration such as OPENAI_API_KEY for OpenAI, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for Anthropic, or GENAI_USERNAME and GENAI_PASSWORD for CodeMie.
Resolve a provider using GenaiProviderManager.getProvider with a Provider:Model string.
Set instructions and prompts, then call perform to obtain a response.
examples.snippet:
<dependency>
  <groupId>org.machanism.machai</groupId>
  <artifactId>genai-client</artifactId>
  <version>1.2.2</version>
</dependency>

org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator config = null;
org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.Genai provider = org.machanism.machai.ai.manager.GenaiProviderManager.getProvider("OpenAI:gpt-4o-mini", config);
provider.instructions("You are a helpful assistant.");
provider.prompt("Describe the GenAI Client library.");
java.lang.String answer = provider.perform();
provider.clear();
examples.description: Practical scenario for adding the library to a Maven project and running a basic OpenAI-compatible generation request.

examples.title: Configure web search and MCP tools
steps: Add the genai-client dependency to the application.
Configure OpenAI credentials and WebSearchTool.type to enable provider-native web search.
Configure MCP.url and MCP.name, plus optional MCP.description and MCP.authorization, to expose an external MCP server.
Resolve and run an OpenAI provider; the provider registers the configured tools during initialization.
examples.configuration:
OPENAI_API_KEY=your-api-key
WebSearchTool.type=web_search_preview
WebSearchTool.city=Prague
WebSearchTool.country=CZ
MCP.url=https://example.org/mcp
MCP.name=Project MCP
MCP.description=Project-specific MCP tools
MCP.authorization=Bearer token
examples.description: Practical scenario for configuring provider-native web search and an MCP server before invoking a real-world prompt.

examples.title: Create and register a custom Java functional tool
steps: Annotate public methods with org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.Tool and annotate exposed parameters with org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.Param.
Create src/main/resources/META-INF/services/org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.FunctionTools and add the fully qualified tool class name.
Use org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.FunctionToolsLoader.applyTools to register compatible tools with a provider.
Prompt the provider and allow the model to call the registered tool when needed.
examples.description: Practical scenario for exposing a host Java method as a model-callable function tool using ServiceLoader discovery.
